name: Grant for the Purchase of Work Related Tools for the Construction Workers
benefit: - An amount of ₹5,000/- as a grant to the members of the Fund, for the purchase of work-related tools once in 5 years. > **Validity****:** The benefit can be applied for after three years from the date of registration.
_eligibility_text:
> **For Registration:** - The applicant should be a resident of Delhi. - The applicant should be a Building/Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 55 years. - The applicant should have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.
> **For Application:** - The applicant should be registered under the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for not less than 3 years. - The applicant should remit their contribution regularly. - The applicant should not exceed 55 years of age. - The applicant must be a registered construction worker.
